verdict.rationale: A built-in AI assistant is a plausible feature for a cap-table and equity-management SaaS, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions an AI assistant, agent, or any way to delegate tasks to one. The documented features are manual workflows: share issuance, round and waterfall modeling, e-signing, a data room, board tools, and human-performed 409A valuations and white-glove migration.
